definition: Compare two named treatments, usually for relative efficacy or preferred choice.
exclusion_criteria: co-administration interactions or a single treatment's efficacy

definition: Assess a drug-drug interaction or the rationale/safety of combination therapy.
inclusion_criteria: drug interaction/interaksi obat, combination therapy, kombinasi
exclusion_criteria: head-to-head comparison where alternatives are not co-administered
boundary_rule: co-administration or interaction overrides general safety

definition: Prevent disease/recurrence, determine prophylaxis duration, or maintain therapy after target attainment.
inclusion_criteria: prophylaxis/profilaksis, prevention, when to stop prophylaxis, target attained/maintenance
exclusion_criteria: active-disease first-line treatment or switching after failure
boundary_rule: prevention or maintenance framing overrides generic indication

definition: Retrieve an explicit guideline, recent update, evidence summary, or year-constrained recommendation.
inclusion_criteria: guideline/panduan, latest/terbaru, evidence based, named year/update
exclusion_criteria: clinical choice without an explicit request for evidence or recency
boundary_rule: explicit evidence, guideline, recency, or year constraint overrides treatment choice

definition: Change, add, or escalate treatment because of failure, resistance, or progression.
inclusion_criteria: switch/penggantian, add-on, failure/gagal, resistance, alternative after progression
exclusion_criteria: initial first-line selection or scheduled maintenance after success
boundary_rule: failure, resistance, progression, switch, or add-on framing overrides initial selection

definition: Select, initiate, or sequence a treatment strategy for a named clinical condition.
inclusion_criteria: first-line choice, best therapy, treatment algorithm, when to start
exclusion_criteria: dose/titration, safety, explicit guideline lookup, switching after failure
boundary_rule: initial treatment choice overrides demographic safety context unless safety is asked
implemented_pattern: treatment algorithm|algoritma terapi|\bfirst line\b|lini pertama|pilihan drug terbaik|pilihan terapi|\bwhen to start\b|kapan (?:mulai|start)|\btatalaksana\b|\bpenanganan\b|\bindication\b|\bindikasi\b|\btarget terapi\b

definition: Assess adverse effects, contraindications, pregnancy safety, or suitability with a comorbidity.
inclusion_criteria: safe/aman, contraindication, adverse/side effect, pregnancy safety
exclusion_criteria: explicit drug-drug interaction or a requested numeric/titration regimen
boundary_rule: harm, suitability, contraindication, or pregnancy-safety wording overrides dose when safety is explicit
implemented_pattern: \bsafe\b|\baman\b|aman atau tidak|aman tidak|contraindication|kontraindikasi|adverse effect|side effect|efek samping|\bpregnan\w*\b|\bhamil\b|ibu hamil

definition: Determine dose, titration, loading regimen, route, or organ-function/age dose adjustment.
inclusion_criteria: dose/dosis, titration/titrasi, loading dose, renal/hepatic adjustment, route
exclusion_criteria: general medication safety without a requested regimen
boundary_rule: requested regimen or adjustment determines the primary information need
implemented_pattern: \bdose\b|\bdosing\b|\bdosis\b|titration|titrasi|loading dose|dose adjustment|renal dose|hepatic impairment dose|penyesuaian dosis|perlu adjustment

definition: Select monitoring parameters, assess treatment response, or perform clinical risk stratification.
inclusion_criteria: monitoring parameters, biomarkers of response, risk stratification
exclusion_criteria: adverse-effect lists without a monitoring decision; long-term treatment efficacy
boundary_rule: monitoring action, response biomarker, or risk score is the requested output

definition: Assess therapeutic effect, clinical outcomes, or long-term outcomes for a treatment.
inclusion_criteria: efficacy, clinical outcome data, long-term outcomes
exclusion_criteria: explicit head-to-head comparison; disease prognosis without a treatment focus
boundary_rule: single-treatment efficacy or outcome evidence is the requested output

definition: Explain mechanism of action, pathophysiology, or a treatment's mechanistic role.
inclusion_criteria: mechanism/cara kerjanya, mechanism of action, pathophysiology
exclusion_criteria: clinical efficacy, treatment choice, disease diagnosis
boundary_rule: mechanism or pathophysiology is explanatory rather than management-oriented

definition: No supported intent can be assigned reproducibly.
inclusion_criteria: no explicit supported information need; unresolved primary intent
exclusion_criteria: any query with a clear supported intent cue
boundary_rule: no supported intent has a sufficiently explicit cue
